newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 21.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Monday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- North Korean defector Hwang Jang-yop arrives in Seoul.
-- Sixty percent of 100 major firm presidents polled expect economy to turn upward in mid-year after slowing down.
-- Peru's interior minister and national police chief resign.
-- New Frontier Party-backed candidate Sukeshiro Terata wins Akita gubernatorial election.
